# Repository workflow

This directory contains public maintenance instructions, a pull-request template, a content-safety workflow and sanitized examples of agent-role guidance.

Engineering decisions, architecture and final review remain human responsibilities. AI assistance is used for bounded implementation, review and test tasks; the presence of agent definitions does not imply continuously running autonomous agents.

- [Pull request template](pull_request_template.md)
- [Automated public checks](workflows/public-content-check.yml)
- [Repository policies](../AGENTS.md)
- [Agent role descriptions](agents/)
- [Runnable standalone .NET example](../examples/README.md)
- [RacePal project overview](../README.md)

No workflows here build or deploy RacePal's private application.
